hook: If you slept in space, you would sleep in a bag on the wall.
title: Astronauts Sleep Strapped To A Wall
description:
On the space station there is no up or down, so astronauts sleep in a bag fixed to the wall. Their arms float up in front of them while they rest. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #IfYouWereInSpace
comment_prompt: Could you sleep like this? Yes or no

scenes.narration: If you slept in space, you would sleep in a bag.
scenes.headline: SLEEP IN A BAG

scenes.narration: That bag is strapped to the wall.
scenes.headline: STRAPPED TO THE WALL

scenes.narration: There is no up or down up there.
scenes.headline: NO UP OR DOWN

scenes.narration: Without a tether, you would drift around the cabin.
scenes.headline: YOU WOULD DRIFT

scenes.narration: And your arms float up in front of you.
scenes.headline: ARMS FLOAT UP

scenes.narration: That is how a relaxed body rests in weightlessness.
scenes.headline: RELAXED, WEIGHTLESS

scenes.narration: The station circles Earth about every 90 minutes.
scenes.headline: EARTH EVERY 90 MIN

scenes.narration: So sleeping in space means a bag on the wall.
scenes.headline: BAG ON THE WALL

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: the light that flickers on camera.
scenes.headline: NEXT: FLICKERING LIGHT
